instruction: A baby grand piano reduced to glowing tube edges, its curved case outline, raised lid prop and three tapered legs all traced in humming magenta neon. The keyboard is a ladder of cyan filament lines and the internal string plate is a grid of thin violet threads visible through the empty body. No solid surfaces exist, only bright luminous wire.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Neon Wireframe Piano in a neon-wireframe style. The keyboard is a ladder of cyan filament lines and the internal string plate is a grid of thin violet threads visible through the empty body. No solid surfaces exist, only bright luminous wire. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
